sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.16
- Apple Pay can be offered at checkout alongside Google Pay. Ask Bottle360 to turn it on once your NMI account has Apple Pay enabled.
- Checkout is tidier: totals agree across the page, there is less clutter, and error messages clear once the problem is fixed.
- Product teasers and category descriptions keep their formatting, and teaser text size is now a Styling Studio setting.
- After an update, visitors on a cached page get the current version of the store instead of a broken one.
